integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, children's cartoon style with bold clean outlines, a wide shot frames a cheerful ten-year-old boy with round cheeks, curly black hair and a yellow tee doodling at a big paper pad on a wooden desk in a sunny bedroom. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as his red marker squeaks across the paper and glowing doodle lines lift off the page and swirl into the air around him. He drops the marker and gasps with delight, eyes wide and sparkling.
overall_soundscape: A red marker squeaks against paper, pages rustle, and soft magical shimmering rises as the doodles lift into the air with faint cartoon twinkle chimes.
non_diegetic_music: A playful ukulele and glockenspiel tune at a quick tempo that swells gently as the doodles come alive.
